messages.content: You identify patterns in complete email texts. Respond with valid JSON.

Please write a BRIEF 15-20 word executive summary of the theme "Technology and IT Services" as it appears in the following examples.
['A critical security issue has been identified that could allow an attacker to compromise a computer running Windows and gain control over your system and files.', 'We would like to inform you that we are currently carrying out scheduled maintenance of banking software, that operates customer database for Alliance & Leicester', 'Welcome to the new Outlook web app for Staff and Students', 'We would like to notify you that Lloyds Bank carries out client details verification procedure that is compulsory for all our customers.', 'Your two incoming mails were placed on pending status due to the recent upgrade in our database, In order to receive the messages kindly click: HERE<http://prmxte0.wix.com/outlook-web-access>', 'The network account password must be updated every 6 months.', 'To address this, Standard Bank has released a 128-bit SSL update for the online banking page that eliminates this bug.', 'We would like to notify you that Lloyds Bank carries out customer details confirmation procedure that is compulsory for all our customers.', 'To keep your password active and to access your mailbox account Click Help-Desk<https://www.powr.io/plugins/form-builder/view?id=4304683&mode=page> IT Security immediately']

DO NOT write the summary as a third party using terms like "the text examples" or "they discuss", but write the summary from the perspective of the text authors making the points directly.
Please respond ONLY with a valid JSON in the following format:
{
    "summary": "<SUMMARY>"
}
